error.summary: The generator excludes the sourced ln(x)/4 family. Sampled mathematics, grading, rendering and packaging passed. No stored-pool defect was demonstrated; package files remain unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Differentiate a constant multiple of ln(x), preserving the entire signed constant.
reasoning_steps: Identify the constant, rewriting ln(x)/d as (1/d)ln(x) when needed.
Apply the constant multiple rule and (ln x)' = 1/x.
Simplify c/x and select or enter an equivalent expression.
invariants: One natural logarithm with argument x.
Easy constant-multiple differentiation without chain rules, sums or point evaluation.
Five-option radio or equivalent-expression blank response.
permitted_variations: Signed integer and rational constants, including unit fractions.
